title: Bartsch to Müller, 19/29 June 1631
author: Jacob Bartsch
summary: Bartsch, forced 'from the stars to the rakes', writes of Kepler's widow and children now at Lauban, his logarithmic tables, the price of the *Ephemerides*, and the poems on Kepler's death.

notes.on: from the stars to the rakes
notes.note: Puns in the Latin: *a libris ad liberos*, from books to children; *ab astris ad rastra*, from the stars to the rakes.
Benjamin Ursinus, who had worked for Kepler at Prague and was now professor of mathematics at Frankfurt an der Oder.
